name: Measure AA Community Grants Program
summary: Rolling grants of up to $300,000 for community-based organisations in economically disadvantaged communities to plan or carry out small shoreline habitat projects around San Francisco Bay, with a shorter application and staff support.

status.quote: We are accepting and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

applicant_types.quote: Community-based organizations in EDCs are eligible to apply for Community Grants.

geography.quote: A habitat project that aims to restore, protect, or enhance tidal wetlands, managed ponds, or natural habitats on the shoreline in the San Francisco Bay Area

access.quote: It provides an alternative pathway for community-based organizations in economically disadvantaged communities to getting a grant

window.quote: You can apply at any time. We are accepting and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

amount.quote: The maximum amount that the Authority will provide for a Community Grant is $300,000.
